registry_purpose: Incremental planning knowledge from Implementation Plan semantic reading. Source policies, accepted plan content and derived Phase 5 implications remain distinct; this is not a duplicate atomic-obligation ledger.

records.knowledge_statement: The implementation plan is the single narrative source for 36 packages; registries, fixtures and validators are supporting evidence. Blueprint and Wallet remain policy authorities. The plan may sequence and estimate but may not change approved policy. Package acceptance gates stay independent.
records.planning_implication: Separate planning-artifact authority from source-policy authority and product execution; retain source-to-acceptance trace.
records.non_applicability: Package/task identifiers do not apply to document-level governance.

records.knowledge_statement: All 36 packages report RA=PASS and IPA=PASS, while product execution is explicitly PRODUCT_NOT_EXECUTED. The 22 principles require usable integrated weekly outcomes (normally <=7 calendar days), documented narrow exceptions, actual dependency mapping, capacity-based commitments, effort/time/token/cost estimates before commitment, separate build/run costs, discovery allocation, estimate-vs-actual learning, full end-to-end DoD, risk-based reversible release and owner control of scope/policy. PoC or Discovery does not replace usable delivery.
records.planning_implication: Do not equate planning acceptance with product tests, deployment, readiness or release; require multidimensional estimates before weekly commitment and actuals to improve forecasts.
evidence_refs: Implementation Plan lines 17–90; package table and POL:BLUEPRINT:5.2.1:01–22
records.non_applicability: Task/test identifiers are not applicable to this cross-package policy inventory; package IDs are retained.

records.knowledge_statement: C01 is an architecture/shared Core planning package with 40 Requirements, 4 Enablers, 13 Tasks, 39 Subtasks, 40 ACs and 40 Test definitions; product execution is zero. Enablers group phase-one baseline/architecture, Core–Adviser contracts/snapshots/jobs/events, resilience/config/privacy telemetry, and incremental rollout/capacity/finance boundaries.
records.planning_implication: Package counts and grouping help mapping but do not establish deliverables, capacity or schedule; test definitions are not execution evidence.
records.non_applicability: Task, AC and Test identifiers are detailed in following sections, not this package overview.

records.knowledge_statement: C01.001 validates actual FastAPI/account/questionnaire/scorer/publication/Alembic/Docker baseline. Entry requires locked main and read-only inventory. Subtasks map routes and behavior, verify Alembic heads/history against a test PostgreSQL, and record tag/digest/E2E evidence; inaccessible runtime remains UNKNOWN. Product state is NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
records.planning_implication: Current runtime/migration readiness needs environment evidence; structural inventory cannot turn UNKNOWN into PASS.
records.non_applicability: No TEST IDs or executed results are stated in this span.

records.knowledge_statement: C01.002 HARD-depends on C01.001 and specifies ownership map, public ports, forbidden private ORM/table access, dependency DAG and local transactions. It is architecture hardening over partial existing code; subtasks and ACs are plans and NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
records.planning_implication: Keep explicit dependency type and service data authority; shared physical database does not imply cross-service permission.
records.non_applicability: Test IDs are not stated on the task row; test specs elsewhere do not imply execution.

records.knowledge_statement: C01.003 plans two R1 deployment units, Core and Adviser; Assistant is interface/boundary only. It HARD-depends on C01.002 and R1-scope approval. Shared-host resources and logical separation require a contract; no deployment is authorized.
records.planning_implication: Deployment-unit target is not a planner-infrastructure choice or deployment permission; record R1 approval as a prerequisite separately.
records.non_applicability: No execution/release evidence is supplied here.

records.knowledge_statement: C01.004 is a reuse/contract adaptation task with execution owner C05b. It preserves deterministic recommendation and published-Snapshot authority, specifies synchronous versioned/provenance-aware output and fail-closed handling for invalid/missing Snapshot. Entry has HARD dependency on C01.001 and CONTRACT dependency on C01.008. Product state NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
records.planning_implication: Preserve distinct dependency types, C05b ownership, and non-regression evidence; never infer a generic hard order from co-reference.
records.non_applicability: Test definitions are not execution outcomes; no TEST result is given here.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:019–021 requires privacy-safe OpenTelemetry with nonpersonal correlation and operational fault/job/outbox observability; SLO, alerts, CPU/RAM, throughput and per-success cost must use versioned measured workloads, defined owners, runbooks, incident drills and error budgets. RUM is limited to page-load/Web Vitals/frontend errors. SigNoz is a conditional Cloud-vs-self-hosted evaluation; recorded capacity prohibits deploying self-hosted SigNoz on the current production VM; new evidence and approval do not automatically authorize deployment. TEST:CORE:C01:019–021 are NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: SLO/capacity numerical thresholds and telemetry provider/retention decisions
records.planning_implication: Do not commit capacity or numeric service criteria from historical host data; distinguish privacy-safe product signals from operational telemetry and retain test specs as NOT_EXECUTED.
records.non_applicability: No actual pilot, SLO measurement or test result is present in the source span.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:022–023 preserves phase-one routes, identity/proof, questionnaire, scoring, publication Snapshot, UI/RTL/a11y, PostgreSQL session authority and existing security/CI gates. Redis remains isolated cache. Alembic is DDL authority; independently inspect heads/history and disposable PostgreSQL16 upgrade/downgrade/restore evidence. Migration-file counts, Compose digest or inaccessible runtime do not prove effective schema; record runtime version as UNKNOWN absent authorized readback. TESTs are NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: Authorized runtime and production schema access remain unknown when unavailable
records.planning_implication: Any Phase 5 plan that touches these product surfaces needs compatibility/regression evidence and an authorized environment; it cannot convert historic/runtime assumptions to verified state.
records.non_applicability: Product baseline does not automatically belong to every Phase 5 deliverable.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:024 separates increment release readiness from complete stage coverage: RAG R1 has no hard dependency on Wallet, billing, gateway or Assistant; approved stage scope and deferred work remain. Cycles target at most seven calendar days; longer slices require a reason, alternatives, dependencies, time/cost cap, testable interim output and review date. Discovery/Delivery actual allocation follows O5-09 80/20 baseline, 90/10 critical, 70/30 uncertain with timebox; ratios do not create capacity or fixed dates. Done needs end-to-end integrated value, acceptance/regression and applicable gates. REQ:CORE:026 maps risk classes, original RG/REL, four budgets and F06 to versioned scoped release dossier; blockers, independent review, stop/rollback and conditional go expiry cannot be waived. TESTs are NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: Release-specific thresholds, owners, cohort, schedule and measured costs remain open
records.planning_implication: Build planning rules around separate release/stage, evidence-based bounded exceptions and original gates; never label test design as accepted release evidence.
records.non_applicability: No week assignment or actual release decision is made here.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:027 mandates bidirectional versioned trace from source/owner/requirement/task/AC/test to release and deferral; approved Wallet v0.20 scope stays visible even when deferred. Selected/approved/released/deferred are distinct. Reprioritization changes sequence only; scope, architecture and gates need owner approval. Growth after stage 3 creates no automatic stage, budget or date; a new service, capacity increase or architecture change are separate decisions. REQ:CORE:032 requires same-workload latency/throughput/resource/failure/security/cost evidence, RFC and independent approval before infrastructure split, with separate build/run costs and forecast-vs-actual learning. Tests are NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: Measured demand, value, risk, compliance/build/run cost, reuse and blast radius per growth proposal; no invented thresholds
records.planning_implication: Maintain deferred scope and source trace. Require measured workload and owner decision for infrastructure/growth; inconclusive evidence yields Hold, not a guessed number.
records.non_applicability: Growth policy is not an allocation or approval of P5 tasks.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:033 confirms Wallet is a modular, closed-loop Shahab-service financial capability, not an external-merchant wallet or prerequisite for first RAG release. One Rial ledger with per-owner accounts and atomic balanced posting is the boundary; provider/vendor/legal applicability remains separate. TEST:CORE:C01:033 is NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: Gift-accounting/vendor/legal details and activation timing are separate/open where source says so
records.planning_implication: Do not place Wallet activation in free-RAG hard path; retain finance controls before any paid release and do not invent accounting/vendor choices.
records.non_applicability: No Wallet implementation or release is approved by this planning statement.

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:037–039 governs resilience: every synchronous cross-service call needs bounded timeout; circuit breakers are conditional on cascading instability and measured policy; retries are bounded/backed off for transient outcomes only. Permanent/validation failures are not retried; unknown financial outcomes are reconciled first with idempotency. Tests are specified but NOT_EXECUTED.
related_open_decision_refs: Approved numeric budgets/policies depend on workload and relevant owner evidence
records.planning_implication: Model resilience costs/risks and verification as explicit factors; do not assume all calls need the same breaker threshold or blind retry semantics.
records.non_applicability: No resilience test execution is recorded.

source_locator.section: C02 identity, organization membership and tenant authorization

records.knowledge_statement: C02 requires identity proof, organization/representative evidence, invitation acceptance and correct account matching as separate predicates before active membership. Removal blocks new organization operations while preserving money/history. Tenant memberships, budgets and records stay isolated. Organization admins have tenant-bounded authority; ordinary membership is not administrative. Limits are admin-set and do not impose a second approver.
records.planning_implication: Represent tenant scope, lifecycle and record preservation in acceptance; keep identity provider/legal/exception details open.
evidence_refs: Implementation Plan lines 1041–1390; C02 identity, organization membership and tenant authorization
records.non_applicability: No source decision was approved and no product implementation/test execution was claimed in this review.

source_locator.section: C02 action authorization, consent, context transfer and sensitive data

records.knowledge_statement: Effective actions independently require entitlement, customer permission and legal/technical feasibility. View, draft and send have different permission levels; sensitive writes require explicit scoped consent/confirmation. Sessions bind customer/domain/role/plan/tool/data policy. Cross-domain context is minimal, purpose/time bound and backend-controlled; permission to share context is not permission to execute. Credentials/OTP/tokens stay out of model memory, RAG and conversation logs. Sensitive financial/admin changes need step-up auth; no blanket second approver.
records.planning_implication: Keep entitlement, consent, scope and feasibility as separate prerequisites; retain freshness/retention details as open.
evidence_refs: Implementation Plan lines 1391–1691; C02 action authorization, consent, context transfer and sensitive data
records.non_applicability: No source decision was approved and no product implementation/test execution was claimed in this review.

source_locator.section: C02 financial records, legal limits, chain access and open decisions

records.knowledge_statement: REQ:CORE:102–130 prohibit assuming OTP/Shahkar covers all exceptions or that tracking proves legal compliance; financial events and provenance links persist; technical/admin retention differs from financially consequential audit-chain records. C12a owns chain content/retention while C02 owns access permissions and audit evidence. DECISION:C02:01–03 remain OPEN for organization proof, provider/matching exceptions, and authorization freshness/retention.
records.planning_implication: Distinguish auditability from legal compliance and keep chain ownership, scoped access and retention classes as separate planning dependencies.
evidence_refs: Implementation Plan lines 1692–2088; C02 financial records, legal limits, chain access and open decisions
records.non_applicability: No source decision was approved and no product implementation/test execution was claimed in this review.

source_locator.section: C03 ownership disposition, shared contracts and gated architecture tasks

records.knowledge_statement: C03 reuses 22 accepted C01 requirements and six C01 tasks; C01 plans and C03 implements. No new requirements/tasks; work is NOT_GRANTED/PLANNED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and requires estimates before weekly commitment. Jobs/outbox/resilience are conditional on actual owner jobs, event consumers and justified failure modes. APIs need versioned schema plus semantic consumer compatibility. Config cannot toggle protected financial policy. Privacy-safe telemetry and measured SLO/capacity are required; static inspection and historical P4/P6 statuses do not prove runtime or tests.
records.planning_implication: Preserve typed dependencies and service-owned state; require measured workloads and owner gates; do not convert static inventory/design into execution.
evidence_refs: Implementation Plan lines 2089–2634; C03 ownership disposition, shared contracts and gated architecture tasks
records.non_applicability: No source decision was approved and no product implementation/test execution was claimed in this review.
